paragraphs: Welcome to the 11th edition of React Weekly Digest. In this weekly roundup, we've handpicked popular React libraries based on GitHub Trends. Save time and stay updated on the most exciting React content for your projects. Fake Glow Material for React Three Fiber is a material designed to create a glow effect from a 3D mesh using GLSL.

Shaders directly, unlike traditional methods relying on post-processing effects, this material offers improved performance, avoiding the usual drawbacks. A React component that converts any image into interactive

Particles. This free npm package provides a React component for creating stunning visual effects, turning images into interactive particles that engage visitors and enhance the overall user experience. React Maps is a collection of

Interactive map components for React, offering over 200 maps including countries and continents. Designed for ease of use with a small dependency size, it includes disputed territories to provide options without taking sides. Users are encouraged to report issues for resolution. React Stacked Toast is a lightweight React component that

Provides stacked toast notification features with a small footprint of approximately 6 kilobytes when gzipped. It allows for easy customization of toast notifications by passing a React component according to your

Preferences. Palettify offers trending themes for websites, accompanied by a playground for instant theme previews, supporting popular UI libraries like MUI and shadcn. Palettify allows users to easily copy and paste beautiful themes into their applications. That concludes this week's React Weekly Digest. Stay tuned for more exciting React libraries and projects. Happy coding!
